reviews.decision_reason: map_capability_coverage preserves the handoff records limited to the declared record ids and assigns direct coverage only when a capability has the same exact need text; the assigned output reflects the expected unsupported records n06-r01 and n06-r07 and direct coverage for the six matched capabilities.

prioritize_needs builds ranks from the supplied evidence_sources handoff, marks non-direct coverage as unsupported, and sorts unsupported needs ahead of supported needs by provenance rank. This deterministically places n06-r01 before n06-r07 because n06-r01 has rank 1 and n06-r07 has rank 7.

synthesize_recommendation retains the first sorted priority row and returns decision prioritize when that row is unsupported. Given the assigned output from prioritize_needs, it correctly reports top_need as isolate faulty execution branches before replay with decision prioritize.
